summary: When a read-only audit degrades on a 401 or 403, the note must quote the API's own message and code rather than assuming a missing scope.
reason: Webflow returns 403 for several distinct conditions. Missing scope is one; plan gating is another (the redirects endpoint answers not_enterprise_plan_site on non-Enterprise sites). A blanket 'add the required scope' hint sends the user after a permission they cannot grant at any price and hides the real cause. Repeating the provider's message and code keeps the remediation honest and survives Webflow adding new 403 conditions.
validated_outcome: redirects audit against a Starter-plan site now reports: This site is not associated with an Enterprise plan [not_enterprise_plan_site] (HTTP 403).
